newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm on Eurobond show, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm on Eurobond show, trade thin.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed on after a London roadshow for Russia's debut Eurobond in otherwise quiet trading overshadowed by an unresolved problem over frozen bonds, dealers said on Friday.
"It has been a very calm day. Today's rise is only due to the roadshow as there is no other positive news," an ICFI Moscow Partners Bank dealer said.
Dealers said trade volume remained low as the market was still overshadowed by the problem of the MinFin bond freeze, with even very small purchases driving prices significantly higher.
"All other Russian instruments were marking time awaiting the results of the roadshow but MinFins managed to firm on that and the market is looking generally up."
